title: Why isn't THIS the way people write their resume? ✍️
description:
Let’s be honest, we want to spend as little as possible with our resume, yes? Well to maximize your time investment, build your resume AROUND a job description. Using the hard skills and keywords in your work history is a quick way to really boost the impact of your resume. #resume #resumetips #jobsearchtips
